Splitsession_Client_Profile (object)
Configures an Splitsession Client profile
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“Splitsession_Client_Profile”
httpHeader
string
“none”
Specifies the Http Header of the SplitSession
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
localPeer
boolean
false
true, false
Specifies the this is a Local Peer of the SplitSession
peerIp*
string
“f5ip” formatted string
Specifies the IP address of the SplitSession peer connected to the out-of-band connection.
peerPort*
integer
0
0 - 65535
Specifies the port of the SplitSession peer connected to the out-of-band connection.
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
sessionLookupType
string
“flow”
“flow”, “http-header”, “session-flow”
Specifies the Lookup Type of the SplitSession
